data.name: Sofie
data.gender_notes: Sofie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Sophia, meaning 'wisdom'. In Christian tradition, often used as a name for the Virgin Mary or for female saints. In Latin, the name was translated as Sapientia, meaning 'intelligence' or 'wise'. The name Sofie carries the meaning “Wisdom, Intelligent, Graceful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Sofie usually hope their child will grow to embody wisdom, intelligent, graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes wisdom and understanding, and the pursuit of knowledge and truth.
data.etymology: Sofie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wisdom, Intelligent, Graceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sofie total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: סופיה
in_hebrew.meaning: חוכמה אלוהית, שכל טוב, ודעת אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם סופיה הוא שורשו של המילה היוונית σοφία, שפירושה חוכמה. בקונטקסט המקראי והנוצרי, סופיה מתארת את החוכמה האלוהית, השכל הטוב והדעת האלוהית. השם הופיע לראשונה בספר משלי, בו מתוארת החוכמה כאחד מהתכונות של אלוהים.

in_greek.name: Σοφία
in_greek.meaning: Σοφία, η σοφία του Θεού, η πνευματική σοφία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Σοφία προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη σοφία, που σημαίνει σοφία. Στο χριστιανικό πλαίσιο, η Σοφία περιγράφει τη σοφία του Θεού, τη πνευματική σοφία και την πνευματική γνώση. Στο Ευαγγέλιο του Λουκά, η Σοφία αναφέρεται ως ένα από τα χαρακτηριστικά του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Sophia
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Sophia derivatur ex verbo Graeco σοφία, quod sapientiam significat. In contextu christiano, Sophia sapientiam divinam, scientiam spiritualem et cognitionem divinam describit. In Ecclesia primitiva, Sophia como virtus et attributum Dei habebatur.

in_english.name: Sofie
in_english.meaning: Divine wisdom, spiritual knowledge, and good judgment
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sofie originates from the Greek word σοφία (sophia), meaning wisdom. In Christian tradition, Sofie symbolizes divine wisdom, spiritual knowledge, and good judgment. Historically, the name has been associated with the concept of wisdom as described in the Book of Proverbs and the New Testament. Sofie is also linked to the Holy Spirit, often referred to as the Spirit of Wisdom. The name has been popularized by various saints and martyrs throughout Christian history.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sofia/Sophie has been popular throughout history, with many notable figures, including royalty, artists, and writers bearing the name. In Eastern European countries, especially Bulgaria, Russia, and Greece, the name is very common. The name offers a strong, noble, and sophisticated image.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Sophia symbolizes wisdom, smartness, and intelligence, which are godly virtues. By bearing the name, one is reminded to strive for wisdom and knowledge, and to use that knowledge to live a virtuous and God-centered life. Plus, the name has strong spiritual roots as it is often associated with the Virgin Mary and various female saints, making it a name with deep Christian meaning and significance.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sophia, the Greek origin of Sofie, means wisdom. In Christian tradition, it represents the divine feminine, the embodiment of wisdom and understanding from God. It is a reminder to seek knowledge and understanding in all aspects of life.

biblical_reference.note: The concept of Sophia is mentioned in Proverbs 1:7 and Luke 11:49, where wisdom is personified as a divine attribute.

historical_references.reference: Sofie Magdalene of Denmark, born in 1523, was the eldest daughter of King Christian II of Denmark and Norway. She was named after her mother, Queen Isabella of Austria, who was called Sophia in the German tradition.
historical_references.context: Daughter of King Christian II of Denmark and Norway, named after her Austrian mother, Queen Isabella of Austria, who was called Sophia in the German tradition.

historical_references.reference: Sofie Friederike of Hanover, born in 1685, was the eldest daughter of Ernst August I, Duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg, who ruled as the Duke of Hanover. She was named after her mother, Princess Sophia of the Palatinate, who was the sister of the future King George I of England.
historical_references.context: Daughter of Ernst August I, Duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg, named after her aunt, Princess Sophia of the Palatinate, who was the sister of the future King George I of England.

It has a modern and elegant sound to it, which makes it appealing for those who value minimalism, elegance, and a touch of femininity. Sofie is often seen on Instagram where it's used as a name for fashion and design influencers showcasing Scandinavian-inspired styles. Pinterest is another platform where Sofie is popular, as users create boards for home décor, fashion, and personal inspiration. TikTok is the latest platform where Sofie is gaining popularity, with many users creating content related to self-care, wellness, and creativity. Overall, the name Sofie is considered trendy and modern, as it represents a clean, simple, and elegant aesthetic.
